text:
Ava: Heads up — a batch of EU invoices for customers billed in EUR got duplicated after a currency-conversion retry. Several missing VAT lines reported.

Matt: Repro steps?

Ava: billing-job `gcp-invoice-generator` v3.4 hit exchange-rate API 502s. It fell back to a cached rate then the retry hook kicked in and created a second invoice instead of deduping. Example: inv_2026_eu_1234 created twice; one copy has `vat:null`.

Sofia: Which customers? Support already flagged Acme EU and Novo.

Ava: Acme EU, Novo, and a couple of small orgs. Quick paste from generation log: 
```json
{"invoice_id":"inv_2026_eu_1234","amount":1200,"currency":"EUR","vat":null,"status":"paid"}
```
That was the fallback run. The expected output should include VAT (e.g. `vat":200` making `amount":1400`). Another run produced the same invoice id but with a doubled compute line instead of adjusting VAT.

Rahul: Likely idempotency key drift on retry. If the key depends on cache-hit boolean we could generate different keys for the same logical invoice. I'll triage invoice-service and the job's retry wrapper.

billing-bot: Automated alert — 6 duplicate invoices created between 2026-03-18 09:12 and 09:18 UTC. Suspected root: exchange-rate API returning 502s triggering fallback + retry.

Matt: Mitigation proposal: pause automatic currency-retry attempts and flip billing-job to "manual reconciliation queue" on exchange lookup failures. Then soft-void duplicates and regenerate.

Ava: Hold on voids until we identify which PDFs were emailed. Support: @Sofia please mark any externally-visible invoices so we can coordinate customer outreach and reissue. :exclamation:

Sofia: On it — marking Acme EU and Novo, sending templated emails to affected customers and CC'ing CS.

Rahul: Root found — idempotency key was constructed as `org_id + billing_period + cache_hit_flag`. If cache_hit_flag differs between attempts we get new keys. Fix: always use `invoice_natural_key(org_id, billing_period, usage_hash)` independent of cache behavior. PR up now.

Matt: ETA for patch + hotfix deploy?

Rahul: Patch PR in review, deploying to staging in ~15m, will promote to prod in ~45m if tests pass. Will also add an alert if exchange-rate fallback is used more than 1% of requests.

Ava: Thanks. I'll start a reconciliation-run ticket and prepare a short customer-facing note for reissued invoices.

Sofia: Template ready, sending after we confirm which invoices were sent.

Matt: Good catch. Follow-up: add an end-to-end test covering exchange-rate failures so invoice amount & VAT remain deterministic across retries. :thumbsup:
